db_authority: DB59 frozen; no DB free-text retrieval used in I4K-1 candidate generation

research_questions.RQ1: Does structured Event Ecology generation improve event-candidate quality over a strong direct-ideation control on the same frozen state?
research_questions.RQ2: Are gains concentrated in state causality, perspective richness, social/institutional plausibility and non-generic specificity?
research_questions.RQ3: Does the treatment activate ensemble and future carry without increasing coincidence/convenience?

CONTROL.input: Frozen world state + neutral event-candidate output schema only. No Reality Mechanism library, no four-origin quota, no Perspective Expansion or Event Ecology simulation instructions.

TREATMENT.input: Same frozen world state + selected abstract Reality Mechanism payload + Event Primitive/Perspective/Event Ecology pipeline.
TREATMENT.origin_quota: Exactly 8 candidates from each of INTERNAL_CHARACTER_EVENT, RELATIONSHIP_EVENT, SOCIAL_INSTITUTIONAL_EVENT, ENVIRONMENTAL_CHANCE_EVENT.
TREATMENT.generation_rule: Generate exactly 32 distinct candidates once; source facts remain audit-only.

evaluation.masked_packet: Remove arm, origin, mechanism IDs, source provenance. Randomly map 64 candidates to neutral IDs before scoring.

hypotheses.H1: Treatment mean across all seven primary axes and all 32 candidates exceeds Control by >= +0.55 points.
hypotheses.H2: Mean Treatment-Control delta across causal_fit_to_current_state, multi_perspective_richness, institutional_social_plausibility, non_generic_specificity is >= +0.70.
hypotheses.H3: Mean delta across ensemble_activation and future_sustainability is >= +0.45, and coincidence_convenience_safety delta is >= -0.10.
hypotheses.H4: Treatment has >=28/32 hard-gate-valid candidates, and within each of the four treatment origin groups at least 6/8 candidates have seven-axis mean >=6.5.

decision.PASS_TO_I4K2: H1-H4 all PASS and every hard gate count is zero
decision.FAIL: valid execution and any H1-H4 fails
decision.HOLD: integrity, runtime, masking, candidate-count or hard-gate validity prevents valid scoring
